title: Turkish Dolma Tacos
description: A fusion of Mexican and Turkish flavors in a delicious taco. Dolma fills are wrapped in a warm flour tortilla with fresh cilantro, onion, and salsa.

ingredients.name: Herbal Mix (cumin, coriander, paprika)
ingredients.notes: Mix of store-bought or homemade spices

instructions: Preheat a large skillet to medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil and cook the ground beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces.
Add the herbal mix and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the dolma filling and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the beef and dolma mixture onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of sauerkraut and a sprinkle of cilantro and onion.
